dashboard.label: TA-devfleet Overview
dashboard.description: Collects a PCI/USB device inventory signature (count + MD5 of the sorted device list via lspci/lsusb) and reports new or removed devices versus the previous cycle using a local

search.query: index=main sourcetype="devfleet:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="devfleet.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="devfleet:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
